svg.desc: PROTEUS DRIFTSCAPE — Evolutionary Protein Disorder: question, observables, model and validation. Proposed design; no measured results.
svg.text: B21 / PROTEUS DRIFTSCAPE — Evolutionary Protein Disorder
Does greater selection efficacy predict disorder within homologous protein domains after GC,
composition, domain age and phylogeny are controlled?
Published domain/proteome analysis, CAIS definition and linked data.
D_KL(p||q)=Σ_c p_c log(p_c/q_c), conceptual codon-divergence term; implement published CAIS
Hold out entire clades/domains; avoid splitting homologous records as independent samples.
Conceptual design • proposed research • full equations, data access and uncertainty in the dossier
